thread.title: Apple to Launch iPad mini 5 and Entry Level 10-inch iPad Next Year - MacRumors

author: Friday December
title: Apple to Launch iPad mini 5 and Entry Level 10-inch iPad Next Year - MacRumors
text: 8 hours ago at 03:47 am The first leaked images just came in people! Rating: 57 Votes 7 hours ago at 04:07 am I wonder if they will arrive bent? Rating: 18 Votes Relentless Power 8 hours ago at 03:51 am I think Apple under estimates the potential with the mini and those who don’t alway favor the larger iPads. Portability in a smaller form factor is still key for the mini when you have those times you want just want ease of use with one hand. Hopefully Apple Pencil support would be a consideration as well. Rating: 17 Votes 7 hours ago at 04:11 am So Apple needs a lower price point. That's not news, that's obvious. But why would I want to buy a "cheaper" version of a flagship device, just because the pricing is ridiculous beyond belief? This will not sell at all ... I really hope Tim Cook leaves with a golden handshake. His obsession with supply chain optimisation and high margins is just horrible. By the way, shareholders will notice that as well. Regardless of all the nice talk about innovation in materials and new technologies. I would not be surprised to see AAPL touch $100. I don't buy any current products anymore. I know it's irrelevant. But the share price has moved and investors see that at least. Rating: 12 Votes 8 hours ago at 03:51 am The reports of iPad mini's death have been greatly exaggerated. Rating: 10 Votes 6 hours ago at 05:07 am Have they lost their mind? iPad mini, 9.7”, 10”, 10.5”, 11” and 12”. At the moment the only one with optimised apps (including Safari) is the 9.7”. This is ridiculous. timber 7 hours ago at 04:52 am This is good news for customers, if true. It shows that basic market forces are still effective...where you spend your money speaks loudest. Dollar-for-dollar, feature-for-feature, the 2018 iPad is the best value in the iPad lineup (IMO). An updated Mini and a new, appropriately priced 10" iPad will definitely generate some interest. I would even say the regular iPad is the best value in anything Apple sells. Rating: 8 Votes 7 hours ago at 04:26 am Yet another screen size? Many apps are not updated for the 11 inch pro yet. That's not Apples problem. By the way, I believe the App Store is slowly dying. I know literally no-one who bought a paid app, maybe a really small In-App purchase. I cannot recall wether Apple has bragged about the payouts to devs recently. Considering the hardware lineup, with limited Xcode support, I know lots of people who simply stopped developing. Also, GDPR, Terms and Conditions, etc. play a role for small devs. Rating: 8 Votes 8 hours ago at 03:52 am Mac Mini... iPad Mini... would iPhone Mini (or SE2) be next?
